title: "Samsung Workaround" is set by default for all phones
symptom: The 'Samsung Workaround' setting is enabled by default on non-Samsung phones, which is confusing and may cause connectivity issues for some users.
cause: The setting is enabled by default for all devices, but the actual workaround only activates on Samsung devices or specific models listed in the code. The default being on is not harmful, but it confuses users.
fix: No code change was made; the maintainer explained that the setting should be left enabled because the workaround only engages on Samsung devices. The issue was closed with the understanding that the setting is fine as default.
evidence_quote: The `Buggy Samsung Workaround` feature doesn't engage unless the phone is a samsung (or specifically listed device) and the wakeup jitter is detected to be a problem. The setting `Samsung Workarounds` allows this to happen. The only effect of changing this setting to off would be to disable the workarounds on a samsung which is likely not a good thing to do.
